reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that translates approval dialog reason text into Simplified Chinese before display while leaving command text and original audit data unchanged.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 审批弹窗显示前，将审批说明自动翻译为简体中文。
summaries.en: Translates DeepSeek Harness approval dialog explanations into Simplified Chinese before they are displayed.

capabilities: Intercepts DeepSeek Harness approval request events
Sends approval reason text to the configured language model for translation
Replaces displayed approval reason text with Simplified Chinese
Preserves the original reason in approval audit events
